message.content: {"query_id": "T02", "candidates": [{"candidate_id": "PC", "facts": [{"paper_uid": "W4408145357", "quote": "In this work, an optimization-aware prerouting timing prediction framework based on multimodal learning is proposed to calibrate the timing changes between placement and routing stages, where the local netlist and layout information are extracted by graph neural network (GNN) and convolutional neural network (CNN), respectively, while the global information along the path is further extracted by Transformer network.", "statement": "该论文提出一种基于多模态学习的优化感知布线前时序预测框架，用图神经网络和卷积神经网络分别提取局部网表与布局信息，并用Transformer提取路径全局信息。"}, {"paper_uid": "W4212927526", "quote": "In this paper, an efficient and accurate pre-routing path delay prediction framework is proposed by employing transformer network and residual model, where the timing and physical information at placement stage is extracted as sequence features while the residual of path delay is modeled to calibrate the mismatch between the pre- and post-routing path delay.", "statement": "该论文提出采用Transformer网络和残差模型的布线前路径延迟预测框架，将布局阶段的时序与物理信息提取为序列特征，并对路径延迟残差建模以校准布线前后延迟差异。"}], "rationale": "若需将领域语言模型用于布线前时序预测，该候选的时序预测与多模态特征提取经验可作为方法互补假设；但其任务为预测而非生成布局，需验证与芯片设计流程的衔接。", "unknowns": "需确认其是否掌握可用的真实设计数据、工艺库许可、可执行设计流程验证条件及当前合作意愿。"}, {"candidate_id": "LXS", "facts": [{"paper_uid": "W4413122177", "quote": "To address this challenge, we propose a multimodal model that integrates PDN, layout, and netlist data. Additionally, we incorporate auxiliary and contrastive learning techniques to capture the differences across various PDNs. Extensive experiments on open-source designs demonstrate the superior performance of our model.", "statement": "该论文提出融合供电网络、布局和网表数据的多模态模型，并引入辅助与对比学习技术以捕捉不同供电网络间的差异，在开源设计上进行了实验。"}, {"paper_uid": "W4403919716", "quote": "In this work, we propose a learning-driven physically aware gate sizing framework to optimize timing performance on large-scale circuits efficiently. In our gradient descent optimization-based work, for obtaining accurate gradients, a multimodal gate sizing-aware timing model is achieved via learning timing information on multiple timing paths and physical information on multiple-scaled layouts jointly.", "statement": "该论文提出学习驱动的物理感知门尺寸优化框架，通过联合学习多条时序路径的时序信息与多尺度布局的物理信息，构建多模态门尺寸感知时序模型。"}], "rationale": "若需将领域语言模型用于时序与物理设计任务，该候选的多模态建模与物理感知优化经验可作为互补假设；但其数据为开源设计，任务为预测与优化，需验证与真实设计流程的适配。", "unknowns": "需确认其是否拥有可用的真实设计数据、工艺库许可、可执行设计流程验证条件及当前合作意愿。"}], "exclusions": []}
